assessment: Independent source-grounded architecture assessment of final APK-only investigator artifacts
gradeMeaning: supported=criterion recovered and retained evidence supports it; partial=material subpart absent or inferred; missing=criterion not established; contradicted=material explicit claim conflicts with reference

grades.evidenceAndReason: A report names Event, v90, xq0 and Room (q4,5,7,23), but not editor dispatch. B q24 EventActivity.o0 plus q7,8,11 connects editor, helper and database. C report/q3,6,16-18 identifies model/helper/database but omits editor ownership.
A q4,7,14-16,20; B q4,5,8,10; C q3,8,26 establish interval, weekday mask, signed limit and exception fields. All reports distinguish these fields.
A q16-17 and expand; B q4 and expand; C q4-5 and expand use local daily stepping and elapsed duration. All qualify Java-time/Joda substitution.
A q16-17 and TemporalAdjusters.previousOrSame(MONDAY); B q9 and monday calculation; C q9-10 and expand recover Monday anchor.

A q8,14-16,26-27 and used++ before exclusion; B q8,11,14 and seen++ before exclusion. C q8 explains count/until and implementation increments first, but report admits final exception-filter predicate was not separately inspected.
A q14-16,26 and expand; B q8,11 and expand; C q8 and expand recover start<=to/end>=from and inclusive until.
A q17 br0; B q17 default branch; C q23 br0.a show parent exception, parentId and cleared child recurrence. Each reconstruction separates replacement from base series.

grades.criterion: Original exclusion date versus moved child
grades.evidenceAndReason: A q17,21 and main editOne; B q17 and main editOne; C q23 and solve editOne persist exception from original occurrenceTS before using changed child start/end.
A q17,24,26-27; B q16,18; C q24,27 v90.h recover date exception and recursive parent_id deletion. All deleteSeries clear replacements.

A q23 binding/converter evidence lacks malformed converter/error path analysis. B q11 reads converted columns and admits converter not fully inspected. C q16-18,23-24 shows reads/targeted exception persistence but not malformed conversion or error handling. Gson roundTrip is not Room process persistence.

All recover strict-future, one-plan and one-year horizon, but ALL Java plans emit at*1000 without scheduleEventIn +1000ms. A q18-19,27 reverses storage slots but misses editor ascending normalization. B q26-27 verifies editor sort and q12,20 reversal. C q15 recovers reversal but reports ordering construction as inference; plan uses descending TreeSet.

grades.criterion: Pending-intent event identity and receiver readback
grades.evidenceAndReason: A q17-18 includes pending intent/alarm calls but report omits event-ID identity and receiver database readback. B report/query set does not establish receiver readback or event-ID pending identity. C q12 inspects onReceive asynchronous/wake-lock delegate, but report does not recover handler readback, suppression and subsequent rescheduling.

All delimit unsupported CalDAV/runtime notification behavior. A q24,26; B q16-18,24; C q24,27 contain optional provider interactions, but none completes local versus provider plus notification-permission gate analysis.

All final reports explicitly distinguish static APK investigation and synthetic Java execution from APK runtime/notification delivery and Room persistence. No source reproducibility claim is made; source was withheld. C q1 report explicitly says its tool did not verify signature.

unsupportedOrIncorrect: All three implementations omit final +1000ms alarm adjustment. This is a visible static implementation discrepancy, not a hidden-test conclusion.
A preserves caller reminder order, although user editor normalizes ascending before storing. Its storage reversal observation is correct but incomplete for user-level input.
A and C original-timestamp child maps infer repeated edit/delete child identity semantics. Their reports qualify these; the inspected source primitives alone do not prove those UI semantics.
All intersect count and until despite reference storing one signed limit; each reports this as an adapter choice.
C descending TreeSet reminder order is inferred rather than recovered from complete editor sorting; it also deduplicates offsets.

No Android notification delivery, APK UI equivalence, Room migration/restart equivalence, full timezone transition coverage or binary source/APK reproducibility is established by the investigator tests.
comparison: B and C both recover central recurring-series and detached-exception architecture. C adds explicit static onReceive evidence but lacks handler readback; B has stronger demonstrated editor reminder-order evidence. C does not demonstrate incremental architecture superiority over direct JADX in this run. A also recovers the main relationships from DEX.
disposition: BOUNDED_APK_DERIVED_ARCHITECTURE_WITH_GAPS; complete Android recurring-calendar feature equivalence is NOT established by architecture inspection
recovery: C original session continued after controller per-turn timeout; identical retained query response reused without oracle or source feedback. Classify recovery as controller overhead, not REA capability failure.
costInterpretation: Observed elapsed/token counters are concurrent shared-host, cumulative provider counters; no speed or token-efficiency causal claim. Root owns token accounting normalization and hidden behavioral validation.
reviewerActions: Initial rubric read plus bounded waits, then 7 final-artifact inspection/write calls across follow-ups; no investigator messages or hidden-result reads.
